title: doctor warns that a user-only skill install does not reach launched sessions
source: intended: a session that jitso launches runs with --setting-sources project, so only the project copy of the skill reaches it
intent: The user copy of the skill serves the owner's own interactive session. A launched worker reads project skills only, so with the user copy alone the project line must say so and name the fix.

stdout.regex: (?m)^warn skill-project: not installed \(run jitso install skill --scope project; sessions that jitso launches load project skills only\)$
